QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Officer of the Day
QuestInfo.0: Yoria is running a Lunar New Year Video Message Project. She's helping deliver messages between officers and their families while they aid in Maple World's restoration! But who will be Officer of the Day?
QuestInfo.1:
Today's lucky Officer of the Day is Beast Tamer Chase!
You'll find Beast Tamer #bunder the Lunar New Year tree#k. Tell her all about the Lunar New Year Video Message Project!
QuestInfo.2: Beast Tamer Chase was thrilled to be Officer of the Day, but she asked for some time to discuss it with her friends.

default.0: Beast Tamer is #bunder the Lunar New Year tree#k.
